notes: Drive-on ferry. Dover–Calais or Folkestone–Coquelles via Eurotunnel. Most frequent cross-Channel crossing; sailings every 30–60 min at peak.
Harwich–Hook of Holland overnight crossing (~7h). DFDS also operates Newcastle–Amsterdam. Ideal for car travellers exploring the Netherlands.
Newcastle–Amsterdam (DFDS, ~18h) with onward connections to Copenhagen. Overnight cabin available. Car ferry.
Multiple routes: Holyhead–Dublin (~3h15), Fishguard–Rosslare (~3h30), Pembroke–Rosslare (~4h), Liverpool–Dublin (~8h overnight), Cairnryan–Belfast (~2h15). Frequent departures.
Overnight ferry Oslo–Copenhagen (~16h). Departs evening, arrives morning. Cabin accommodation available. DFDS Crown Seaways.
Overnight ferry Oslo–Amsterdam (~18h). DFDS Pearl Seaways departs Oslo in the afternoon, arrives Amsterdam next morning.
Overnight ferry Stockholm–Helsinki (~17h) or Stockholm–Turku (~11h). Viking Line and Tallink Silja operate daily sailings with cabin and entertainment options.
Overnight ferry Stockholm–Tallinn (~16h). Tallink Silja departs evening, arrives morning. Popular route with onboard shopping and dining.
Multiple Italian ports to Greece. Ancona–Patras ~22h, Bari–Patras ~17h, Brindisi–Igoumenitsa ~8h. Car ferry with cabins. Corfu stop available on many routes.
Ancona–Split ~10h overnight (Jadrolinija). Ancona–Zadar ~7h. Seasonal high-speed catamaran services also available.
Barcelona–Palma ~8h overnight or 4.5h day ferry. Valencia–Palma ~8h. Frequent sailings; Baleàlia and Trasmediterranea operate the route.
Very short crossing (~20 min) across the Strait of Messina. Ferries run almost continuously 24/7. Drive-on car ferry. Also train-ferry connection via Ferrovie dello Stato.
Naples–Cagliari ~12h overnight (Tirrenia). Seasonal routes also connect Salerno with Sardinian ports.
Civitavecchia–Cagliari ~11h, Civitavecchia–Olbia ~7h. Genova and Livorno also serve Sardinia with overnight crossings. Multiple operators with car ferry options.
Piraeus (Athens port) is the main hub. Piraeus–Mykonos ~5h, Piraeus–Santorini ~8h (Blue Star), ~5h (fast ferry), Piraeus–Heraklion ~9h overnight. Extensive network.
Cadiz–Las Palmas ~40h. Inter-island ferries (Fred. Olsen, Naviera Armas) are much shorter: e.g. Fuerteventura–Lanzarote ~25 min. Long-haul mainland crossings are overnight.
Limited direct routes. Kinmen–Xiamen ~30 min (small passenger ferry). Matsu–Fuzhou ~2h. Visa and political restrictions apply; check current status before travel.
Fukuoka–Busan ~3h by Beetle hydrofoil or ~6h by overnight ferry. Osaka–Busan ~18h overnight (Panstar). Shimonoseki–Busan ~14h overnight (Camelia Line).
Frequent high-speed ferries run 24/7 (~1h). TurboJet from Hong Kong–Macau Outer Harbour; Cotai Water Jet from Taipa. Fares ~HK$165–220. Book ahead at peak times.
BC Ferries operates multiple routes: Tsawwassen–Swartz Bay (Victoria) ~1h35, Horseshoe Bay–Nanaimo ~1h35. Scenic sailing through Gulf Islands. Cars and foot passengers welcome.
State-operated ferry system connecting Southeast Alaska communities. Bellingham–Juneau ~60h (full Inside Passage). Essential transport in roadless communities. Cabins available.
Buenos Aires–Colonia del Sacramento ~1h (fast ferry) or ~3h (Buquebus slow). Buenos Aires–Montevideo ~2h15 (fast) or ~3h (slow). Frequent departures. Car ferry available on some routes.
